ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, rectangle $ABCD$ is folded along $CE$ such that point B falls exactly on point F on $AD$. If $AB\colon BC=2\colon 3$, then what is the value of $\cos\angle DCF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since rectangle $ABCD$ has $AB:BC=2:3$,\\
let $AB=2m$, then $BC=3m$,\\
thus $AB=CD=2m$, and $AD=BC=CF=3m$, $\angle D=90^\circ$,\\
therefore $\cos\angle DCF=\frac{DC}{FC}=\frac{2m}{3m}=\boxed{\frac{2}{3}}$.
